trails.label: Trails
trails.hint: The last {s} s of each car, on the centre line, like the car: the source does not say where across the track it is. Where the position is missing, the trail stops: it is never filled in.
trails.hintSpeed: By speed: at each point, the last measured speed (at most {age} s old), not interpolated. If there is none, the point is grey (“no data”).
